narration:0:1311003001:1.text: Valka knocks on the door. The sound echoes throughout the ruins, but no one answers.

say:2:1311003002:1.text: Curious... Is she not here? Perhaps she is praying and did not hear us.
say:2:1311003002:1.source_cn: 奇怪……她不在吗？唔……或许是在祈祷，没有听见……

say:3:1311003003:1.text: Your friend lives in a crypt...?
say:3:1311003003:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，这里就是你那位朋友的家？她……住在地道里？

say:4:1311003004:1.text: Indeed. This is Carolina's home. This place was once the ancestral mansion of her kin. Her family was once one of the three great noble families in these parts.
say:4:1311003004:1.source_cn: 没错。这是卡列琳娜——我这位朋友——的家，这里以前是她...

say:6:1311003006:1.text: Now...? Similar to the remnants here... Dead, decayed, and forgotten.
say:6:1311003006:1.source_cn: 现在……和这片废墟一样死去，腐朽，然后被遗忘了。

say:7:1311003007:1.text: Time is of the essence. We cannot afford to wait idly for her here. Come with me. Let us seek the <style="highlight">undead flames</style> to unlock the door.
say:7:1311003007:1.source_cn: 时间紧迫，不能在外面干等她。跟我来，我们去拿开门用的<...

choice_prompt:8:1311003007.text: Time is of the essence. We cannot afford to wait idly for her here. Come with me. Let us seek the <style="highlight">undead flames</style> to unlock the door.
choice_prompt:8:1311003007.source_cn: 时间紧迫，不能在外面干等她。跟我来，我们去拿开门用的<style=highlight>亡灵之焰</style>。

say:9:1311003008:1.text: They are known among mortals as will-o'-wisps. We can utilize these flames to light the lamps on the door and thus gain access.
say:9:1311003008:1.source_cn: 就是你们常说的“鬼火”。用亡灵之焰点亮门上的灯盏，就可...

say:10:1311003011:1.text: So, these "undead flames" are like keys. Is the place where they're kept far from here?
say:10:1311003011:1.source_cn: 呃，看来“亡灵之焰”就是开门用的钥匙，放钥匙的地方离这...

say:11:1311003012:1.text: Carolina holds a deep-seated love for this estate and has never left its confines, and the so-called "keys" reside within the ruins of the mansion.
say:11:1311003012:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜对这座宅邸充满感情，一直不曾远离此地。打开暗门...

say:12:1311003013:1.text: Uh... Chippy has a question. If you put your special key where others can get it, doesn't that defeat the purpose of locking your secret door?
say:12:1311003013:1.source_cn: 呃……满满有个问题，把暗门的钥匙放在别人能拿到的地方，...

say:13:1311003014:1.text: In truth, having a secure door is inconsequential. It may be essential when one is alive. However, for us, who have experienced death and endured for eons, wealth and material possessions are of no import.
say:13:1311003014:1.source_cn: 其实，“锁门”毫无意义。在生前或许需要，但对我们这样先...

say:14:1311003015:1.text: We've witnessed those that we hold dear pass away one by one. Our surroundings slowly change into the unfamiliar, until no link remains. In the end, we can only live in the ruins of our past, reminiscing and suffering the torture of our memories...
say:14:1311003015:1.source_cn: 你亲眼看着认识的人渐渐死去，周围一切慢慢变得陌生，最后...

say:15:1311003016:1.text: People here fear us, cursing our names and ostracizing us. Ha... They wouldn't even dare come near, let alone steal or rob from this place.
say:15:1311003016:1.source_cn: 更何况，这里的人们害怕我们、诅咒和远离我们。哈……他们...

say:16:1311003017:1.text: Locking the door serves more as a ritual, a memento of sorts. It gives us the feeling that we are not entirely dead and provides a semblance of our former lives.
say:16:1311003017:1.source_cn: 所谓的“锁门”更像是一种仪式，或者纪念。这会让我们感觉...

say:17:1311003018:1.text: I didn't know becoming a Graveborn was so dreadful...
say:17:1311003018:1.source_cn: 原来成为永生的亡灵，是这么痛苦的事情……

say:18:1311003019:1.text: Not every Graveborn is subjected to such pain. Let's not dwell on it. The undead flames lie amidst the <style="highlight">ruins of the main manor</style>. We need to open the door as soon as possible.
say:18:1311003019:1.source_cn: 并不是所有的亡灵都这么痛苦……算了，不提这些。亡灵之焰...

say:20:1311003009:1.text: Yes, Carolina and I have been acquainted for a long time, and we have always enjoyed a cordial relationship.
say:20:1311003009:1.source_cn: 嗯，我和卡列琳娜认识很久，关系一向不错。

say:21:1311003010:1.text: Should you employ the specific undead flames to light the lamps on the door, it shall unlock.
say:21:1311003010:1.source_cn: 只要用特定的亡灵之焰点亮门上的灯盏，就可以打开这扇暗门了。

choice:8:1:2.text: You know how to open the door?
choice:8:1:2.male: You know how to open the door?
choice:8:1:2.female: You know how to open the door?
